description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017 Order under 22
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order issued under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, extending the validity period of a previous order. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving legal/statutory instruments, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions Basil Rajapaksa as Minister of Finance, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would make it a government-related type (1-3).
